scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --parallel run dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @si-arena/web dev
scripts.dev:server: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @si-arena/server dev
scripts.dev:worker: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @si-arena/worker dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @si-arena/server build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm test
